title: UC identifier ledger
description: Append-only record of every UC identifier (X.Y.Z) ever issued. Git stores id, status, firstSeenVersion, and fingerprint revisions recorded at issuance and at each release. The build computes the live content fingerprint into dist/data/id-ledger.json. Removed rows are never reissued.

identityGuaranteeSince.description: First catalogue release that ships permanent-identity enforcement.

identityBaselineVersion.description: Last release before enforcement. Revision 1 of every identifier present in it is hashed from that release's tagged content.

identityBaselineCommit.description: Commit of the identity baseline release tag.

fingerprintFields.description: Default fingerprint surface (Splunk-platform use cases). A revision hashed from a different surface records its own fingerprintFields.
Fields this revision was hashed from, when not the header default (set by the UC's primary product in data/splunk-products.json; see ADR-0017).

contentFingerprint.description: In git, the last recorded fingerprint (mirrors the last fingerprintRevisions row). In dist/data/id-ledger.json, the fingerprint of the sidecars the build read, which may be ahead of the last revision until a version is cut.

fingerprintRevisions.description: Append-only history of content fingerprints captured when the identifier is issued and when release.yml records a version cut. Regeneration must never shorten this list. A pull request does not append a row for a title or SPL edit.

removedInVersion.description: Release that removed the identifier. Omitted when removal predates the identity baseline and the release was not reconstructed.

replacedBy.description: Removed entries only: the active identifier that now carries this use case's content, taken from the `to` of a `remove` row in data/uc-id-migrations/.
